title: Tensor decomposition of $e^+e^-\toπ^+π^-γ$ to higher orders in the dimensional regulator
summary: We present a first study of the scattering process $e^+ e^-\toπ^+π^-γ$ beyond next-to-leading order, aimed at providing preliminary insights required for future NNLO predictions for radiative return processes. A complete four-dimensional tensor decomposition of the amplitude is developed, and the associated one-loop polarised amplitudes are evaluated analytically to higher orders in the dimensional regulator, as required for NNLO accuracy.
